The Knights compete as members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. The Knights, in the program's 54th season of basketball, were led by seventh-year head coach [[Johnny Dawkins]] and played their home games at the [[Addition Financial Arena]] on the university's main campus in [[Orlando, Florida|Orlando]], [[Florida]]. They finished the season 18–14, 8–10 in [[2022–23 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC Play]] to finish in 7th place. They defeated [[2022–23 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|SMU]] in the first round of the [[2023 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC Tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2022–23 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]]. The Knights received an at-large bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]], where they defeated [[2022–23 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2022–23 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]].{{cite web |last=Goodall |first=Zach |date=2023-03-15 |title=Florida Gators' Season Comes to Close as UCF Thumps UF in NIT |url=https://www.si.com/college/florida/basketball/florida-gators-basketball-season-close-thumped-ucf-knights-nit |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=Sports Illustrated |publisher=FanNation}} This was also the last season UCF played in the [[American Athletic Conference]] before moving to the [[Big 12 Conference]].{{cite news |url=https://www.ucf.edu/news/ucf-to-join-big-12-july-1-2023/ |title=UCF to Join Big 12 July 1, 2023 |publisher=University of Central Florida |date=2012-10-06 |accessdate=2022-06-10}} ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 UCF Knights men's basketball team|Knights]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 18–12 overall and 9–9 in [[2021–22 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in sixth place. {{cite web |title=2021‑22 UCF Knights Men’s Basketball Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/central-florida/men/2022-schedule.html |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=Sports‑Reference}}They defeated [[2021–22 South Florida Bulls men's basketball team|South Florida]] in the first round of the [[2022 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]] in the quarterfinals. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
